risk_note: RV1, agent stream sweeper only (stream/sweeper/loop.ts); no migration, no contract change, no outcome change (withdraw lane, model Claude Opus 5.5; orchestrator ruling D10-1004; agent follow-up list open-followups-20261108 #27). Before this task a tick waited without a bound on its pinned lock connection (lock query, SELECT 1 before each step, unlock); a half-open connection answers only within TCP retransmission (~15 min) and a stall before tick_timeout was armed left the loop's running flag set, so every later tick was skipped as busy and left-over runs were not finalized. Now each wait on the pinned connection marks the tick as stalled and the next 'tick' timer gives up a tick stalled for at least min(tickTimeoutMs, floor(intervalMs × (1 − jitterRatio))): one error line (stage, error_name only), the timer promise resolves, and the tick runs on a newly borrowed connection; a late answer of the abandoned connection is ignored (no step, no log, cursor unchanged; a late lock is given back quietly). No extra timer is armed; a step in flight is still 'busy'; the header contract documents the new path. Covered: lock / SELECT 1 / unlock stuck with late answer and late failure (#1–#6), normal numbers after an abandoned tick (#7); frozen stream-recovery and stream-sweeper suites pass unchanged. Test-machine full verify not run (AWS runners disabled, D10-555; CI is the full verification).
